biggest_catch: This is a 5-state offer (TX, LA, MS, AL, FL only) and the email you use at account opening must match the email you submitted to get the promo code — plus the terms state 'only the person to whom this offer is addressed is eligible,' so you must enroll through Hancock Whitney's own page/form, not a shared code. The full $600 also requires opening BOTH accounts at the same time and meeting every requirement.
catches: Use the required promo code when opening your new checking and/or savings account by the offer expiration date of 2/28/2027; the email given at account opening must match the email address submitted to get the offer promo code.
Offer valid only to residents of Texas, Louisiana, Mississippi, Alabama, or Florida.
'Only the person to whom this offer is addressed is eligible for this offer' — non-transferable; enroll through Hancock Whitney's own offer page, not a third-party-shared code.
$300 checking bonus: open a Freestyle Checking account and set up and receive a total of $2,000 or more in direct deposits within the first 90 days of opening.
$100 savings bonus: open a Freestyle Savings account and deposit $5,000 within 30 days of opening and maintain a $5,000 minimum daily balance for 60 days.
Additional $200 bonus: open both accounts at the same time and meet all requirements for both.
Bonuses are deposited into the new accounts within 135 days of opening; account(s) must be open and with a positive balance at the time of bonus award, otherwise the bonus is forfeited.

A qualifying direct deposit is a recurring electronic payment (payroll, pension, Social Security, government or monthly income) by an employer or external agency; excludes transfers between your own accounts, Zelle/PayPal/Cash App, tax refunds, stimulus payments, wire transfers, and branch/ATM/mail/mobile/online-transfer deposits.

Available to new Hancock Whitney checking clients 18+; includes new-to-bank clients and existing clients who currently do not have a checking account, have not closed a checking account in the past 90 days, and did not have a checking account closed with a negative balance in the past 3 years.

A $25 minimum deposit is required at account opening for each account (an opening deposit, not a fee). If the checking account is closed within 180 days, a $20 closing fee is assessed and the bank may deduct the bonus from the closing balance.

Freestyle Checking $10 monthly service charge waived with: primary holder under 18 or 64+ with valid DOB on file, or one or more client-initiated debit/credit transactions per statement cycle. Freestyle Savings $5 monthly charge waived with: under 18 or 64+, $250+ minimum daily balance, or one client-initiated transaction per cycle.
Limit of one consumer savings-related bonus and one consumer checking-related bonus per household every 2 calendar years, and a household lifetime maximum of 2 checking and/or 2 savings bonuses.
The Bank may change or discontinue the offer at any time without notice. Bonuses may be considered interest and may be reported on IRS Form 1099 (taxable).

steps: Go to Hancock Whitney's official 'Your Checking and Savings Offer' page and submit your email to receive the required promo code (offer expires 2/28/2027; TX, LA, MS, AL, FL residents only).
Open a new Freestyle Checking account by February 28, 2027 using the promo code, with the same email address you submitted to get the code ($25 minimum opening deposit).

Set up and receive a total of $2,000 or more in qualifying direct deposits (recurring payroll/pension/SS/government income; no own-account transfers, Zelle/PayPal/Cash App, wires, or branch/ATM deposits) within the first 90 days to earn $300.

Optionally open a Freestyle Savings account at the same time, deposit $5,000 within 30 days, and maintain a $5,000 minimum daily balance for 60 days to earn $100 — plus an additional $200 for opening both accounts at the same time and meeting all requirements.
Keep the accounts open with positive balances; bonuses are deposited within 135 days of account opening.
